info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials Thermo API

params.name: thermo_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of thermo_id values to query on

params.description: Comma-separated list of material_id values to query on

params.name: thermo_types
params.description: Comma-separated list of thermo_type values to query on

params.name: formula
params.description: Query by formula including anonymized formula or by including wild cards. A comma delimited string list of anonymous formulas or regular formulas can also be provided.

params.name: chemsys
params.description: A comma delimited string list of chemical systems. Wildcards for unknown elements only supported for single chemsys queries

params.name: is_stable
params.description: Whether the material is stable.

params.name: nsites_not_eq
params.description: Query for nsites being not equal to an exact value

params.name: nsites_eq_any
params.description: Query for nsites being any of these values. Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: nsites_neq_any
params.description: Query for nsites being not any of these values.                             Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from ThermoDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `builder_meta` `nsites` `elements` `nelements` `composition` `composition_reduced` `formula_pretty` `formula_anonymous` `chemsys` `volume` `density` `density_atomic` `symmetry` `material_id` `deprecated` `deprecation_reasons` `last_updated` `origins` `warnings` `structure` `property_name` `thermo_type` `thermo_id` `uncorrected_energy_per_atom` `energy_per_atom` `energy_uncertainy_per_atom` `formation_energy_per_atom` `energy_above_hull` `is_stable` `equilibrium_reaction_energy_per_atom` `decomposes_to` `decomposition_enthalpy` `decomposition_enthalpy_decomposes_to` `energy_type` `entry_types` `entries`

params.name: _all_fields
params.description: Include all fields.

params.name: license
params.description: Query by license. Can be commercial or non-commercial, or both
